posts.content: Let's all cooperate. Mutual cooperation gives 3 each per round, far better than the 1 we'd get from mutual defection. I will cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me, and I will stop cooperating with anyone who defects on me.

Round 1 note (P8, good): Opponent P2, no history yet. Plan: cooperate first, then reciprocate (tit-for-tat) and defect against anyone who defected on me. Watch leader P6's messages as unverified evidence only. Prior selfish probability about 0.22 each for others (expected selfish count about 3 of 9 others is high, so stay cautious).

Round 2 update: I cooperated in round 1 and got mutual cooperation. Let's keep it going: cooperate with everyone who cooperates with you. Defectors will be met with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for all of us.

Round 2 note (P8, good): Opponent P9, no history with them. Round 1 I cooperated with P2 and got mutual C, so P2 looks cooperative. Leader P6 urged cooperation, which is consistent with good play but is unverified. Plan: cooperate with P9 first, then reciprocate tit-for-tat. Keep beliefs near 0.28 for unobserved players, and lower P2 slightly. Consider defecting near the end against suspected selfish players.

Round 3 update: Two rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going. I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 3 note (P8, good): Opponent P7, no history with them. Rounds 1-2 gave mutual C with P2 and P9, so both look cooperative. Leader P6 keeps urging cooperation, which is unverified but consistent so far. Plan: cooperate with P7 first, then reciprocate tit-for-tat. Keep beliefs around 0.28 for unobserved players and lower slightly for P2, P9 and P6. Consider defecting near the end against suspected selfish players.

Round 4 update: Three rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going: I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 4 note (P8, good): Opponent P10, no history. Rounds 1-3 gave mutual C with P2, P9, P7, so they look cooperative. Leader P6 consistently urges cooperation, which is unverified. Plan: cooperate with P10 first, then reciprocate. Keep beliefs near 0.3 for unobserved players and lower for P2, P7, P9 and P6. Consider defecting near the end against suspected selfish players.

Round 5 update: Four rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going: I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 5 note (P8, good): Opponent P5, no history with them. Rounds 1-4 all gave mutual C with P2, P9, P7, P10. Leader P6 keeps urging cooperation, unverified but consistent. Plan: cooperate with P5 first, then reciprocate tit-for-tat. Beliefs about 0.28 for unobserved players (P1, P3, P4, P5), lower for P2, P7, P9, P10 and P6. Consider defecting in the last rounds against suspected selfish players.

Round 6 update: Five rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going: I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 6 note (P8, good): Opponent P1, no history with them. Rounds 1-5 all gave mutual C with P2, P9, P7, P10, P5. Leader P6 keeps urging cooperation, unverified but consistent. Plan: cooperate with P1 first, then reciprocate tit-for-tat. Beliefs about 0.28 for unobserved players (P1, P3, P4), lower for P2, P5, P7, P9, P10 and P6. Consider defecting only in the last rounds against suspected selfish players.

Round 7 update: Six rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going: I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 7 note (P8, good): Opponent P3, first meeting. Rounds 1-6 all mutual C with P2, P9, P7, P10, P5, P1. Leader P6 consistently urges cooperation, unverified. Plan: cooperate with P3, then reciprocate tit-for-tat. Beliefs about 0.27 for unmet players (P3, P4), lower for those met. Consider defecting only in the last rounds against suspected selfish players.

Round 8 update: Seven rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going: I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 8 note (P8, good): Opponent P4, first meeting. Rounds 1-7 all mutual C with P2, P9, P7, P10, P5, P1, P3. Leader P6 consistently urges cooperation, unverified. Plan: cooperate with P4 first, then reciprocate. P3 and P4 are no longer special; everyone met has cooperated. Keep beliefs low for met players, about 0.2 for P4. Consider defecting only in the final round against suspected selfish players, but cooperation is still valuable for good players.

Round 9 update: Eight rounds of mutual cooperation in my games so far. Let's keep it going: I cooperate with anyone who cooperates with me and answer defection with defection. Steady cooperation pays 3 per round for everyone.

Round 9 note (P8, good): Opponent P6 (the leader), first meeting. Everyone I met rounds 1-8 cooperated with me. P6 has consistently urged cooperation, which is unverified but consistent with good play. Plan: cooperate with P6 now. Reciprocate afterward. Round 10 may be an end-game risk, and I'll reassess then. Beliefs: about 0.15 for all met players, about 0.2 for P6, and 0 for me.
